zh.title: 庆怜｜伦敦时装周 2025
zh.summary: 庆怜伦敦时装周人物内容：衔接形象准备与不同场景下的制作。
zh.preview: 人物内容跨越不同场景时，形象准备与制作安排需要相互配合。庆怜项目将人员沟通、场景安排和影像工作放在同一项内容任务中。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与形象准备、场景安排、人员沟通与影像制作，把人物准备与场景中的拍摄工作衔接起来。
zh.context: 本案围绕庆怜在伦敦时装周期间的人物内容展开。工作重点是将人物形象落实到具体场景中的制作，完成与此次伦敦项目对应的内容。

narrativeSections.heading: 场景变化中的制作配合
narrativeSections.text: 每个场景都涉及人物准备与制作人员的配合。本案的工作范围同时包含形象与场景，因此内容制作需要兼顾两者，而不是分别处理完再临时拼接。

narrativeSections.heading: 人物与环境共同进入交付
narrativeSections.text: 交付包括庆怜的人物造型与城市环境影像，以及对应的形象准备和制作配合。案例体现的是围绕同一人物组织不同场景内容的能力。

deliverables: 形象准备、场景与人员配合
庆怜人物造型及城市环境影像
outcomes: 人物与环境内容构成此次项目的影像交付，制作范围同时覆盖拍摄前的形象准备。

en.title: Qinglian | London Fashion Week 2025
en.summary: Fashion week content for Qinglian, linking talent preparation with production across settings.
en.preview: Content made across settings depends on preparation and production working together. Qinglian’s London project combined people liaison, settings and photography within one content assignment.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to image preparation, settings, people liaison and photography, connecting preparation for the talent with the shoot.
en.context: This project centred on Qinglian’s talent content during London Fashion Week. Its focus was the practical relationship between image preparation and production in the settings used for the London project.

narrativeSections.heading: Working across settings
narrativeSections.text: Each setting involves both the talent’s preparation and the people making the content. With both within our scope, the production work had to account for their relationship throughout the assignment.

narrativeSections.heading: Content built around one person
narrativeSections.text: The delivery comprised fashion portraits and imagery within the city, together with the preparation and production support behind them. The case demonstrates talent content production across settings.

deliverables: Image preparation, settings and people liaison
Qinglian fashion portraits and city-setting imagery
outcomes: The project produced a set of talent and location imagery, with image preparation included in the production scope.
